text:
anya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
anya: - finished route-policy PR (adds per-tenant weight overrides) and deployed to staging :tada:
anya: - noticed ci/route-lint is flapping on one rule, throwing timeout on the auth-mock step
anya: blockers: need someone to pair on the auth-mock timeout; can't reproduce locally
anya: today: will dig into the mock, and open a follow-up to add a retry in the lint job

jordan: ack, I'll take a look at the auth-mock logs in staging in ~30m. saw similar flake yesterday
jordan: FYI I bumped the JWT rotation window in the canary config to 2h to reduce churn
jordan: no major regressions so far, but want eyes from @sam before promoting to prod

lee: what PR number for the route-policy change? will add it to canary checklist
lee: also, are the new weight overrides compatible with the proxy cache keys? we should avoid cache misses
lee: if not, we should add an opt-in header to preserve current behavior

anya: PR is https://git.internal/rw-infer/infra/pulls/428 — added notes about cache behavior in the description
anya: TL;DR: no cache-key changes by default, opt-in header x-rw-weight allows override per-tenant

priya: quick heads-up: rate-limit telemetry in staging is spiking for some tenants after the policy change (more 429s)
priya: digging in now — could be client misconfig or our weight math being too aggressive for short bursts
priya: reassigning to myself to follow-through, will report back with a breakdown by route

sam: can anyone drop a short snippet of the weight math? want to sanity-check before I review the PR
sam: also pinging @lee for cache concerns

anya: snippet pasted below:
```
# weight override math (simplified)
def effective_capacity(base_capacity, tenant_weight):
    return max(1, int(base_capacity * float(tenant_weight)))
```

anya: it's intentionally conservative — floors to 1 and uses int to avoid fractional tokens

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deployment 2025-07-02T09:02:12Z succeeded for infra/pulls/428 :white_check_mark:

jordan: thanks — I'll look at the auth-mock trace and share findings in this thread
jordan: if it's a network hiccup, we can short-circuit the lint step with a retry and a backoff

priya: update: initial breakdown shows 70% of 429s on /v1/embeddings with tenant=mobile-app during a 2s burst window
priya: plan: throttle the client-side burst at the SDK level and add a brief warmup to the route policy for that tenant

lee: sounds reasonable. @anya can you add a canary tag to the PR so we only roll to the mobile-app tenant first?

anya: done — added canary=mobile-app label and a rollout plan in the PR description
anya: also added a short note for SRE about telemetry: route-policy can emit metric rw.policy.override_count

sam: will review PR later today, prioritize the canary gating and cache check. if all good I'll approve and schedule a slow rollout
sam: thanks for the heads-up on the 429s @priya — nice catch

anya: one more small ask: could someone from infra team sanity-check the route-lint job retry to avoid masking real auth regressions?

jordan: I'll put a quick patch up to add 2 retries with exponential backoff and a prominent flag to opt-out. will link PR here

jordan: PR for lint retry: https://git.internal/rw-infer/infra/pulls/431 — small change, ea test passes in my run

priya: thanks everyone. I'll monitor telemetry after the canary and drop a post with the numbers

sam: great sync. if anything urgent ping me in DMs. otherwise we'll reconvene in tomorrow's async checkin :slightly_smiling_face:
